description: This file contains implementation of ASN.1 message structures and methods for RRC NR protocol messages related to UL CCCH message IEs, including encoding, decoding, JSON serialization, and class methods for various message types and enumerations.

classes.name: init_ue_id_c
classes.description: Class representing initial UE identity with methods for setting, destroying, JSON serialization, packing, and unpacking.

classes.name: rrc_pos_sys_info_request_r16_ies_s

classes.name: reestab_ue_id_s
classes.description: Structure for reestablishment UE identity including c-RNTI, physical cell ID, and MAC.

classes.name: rrc_reest_request_ies_s
classes.description: Structure for reestablishment request IE sequence.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request_ies_s
classes.description: Structure for resume request IE sequence.

classes.name: rrc_setup_request_ies_s
classes.description: Structure for setup request IE sequence.

classes.name: rrc_sys_info_request_ies_s
classes.description: Structure for system info request IE sequence with critical extensions.

classes.name: rrc_sys_info_request_s
